units.text: EXT. MONASTERY BELL TOWER - DAWN (1944)
A stone belfry open to the sky, half the roof gone.
Below, the valley is smoke and orchard.
A cracked bell hangs silent.
SERGEANT THADDEUS KRUGER, thirties, lies prone on the floor with a rifle.
CORPORAL NIKOLAI BOGDANOV, twenties, crouches by the stair with a radio.
A MONK, BROTHER ANSELMO, seventies, sits against the wall with rosary beads running through his fingers.
He's in the second window, third floor of the mill.
units.name: KRUGER

units.text: Who is?
units.name: BOGDANOV

units.text: The man who has been shooting at us since four.
units.name: KRUGER

units.text: He is a boy. I saw him yesterday, bringing water to the cows.
units.name: BROTHER ANSELMO

units.text: Then it's a boy with a rifle, Father.
units.name: KRUGER

units.text: I am not your father. I am only an old man who rings the bell.
units.name: BROTHER ANSELMO

units.text: Sir, command says hold until eight.
units.name: BOGDANOV

units.text: Command is thirty miles from here and has never smelled this smoke.
units.name: KRUGER

units.text: They've asked us to confirm positions.
units.name: BOGDANOV

units.text: Tell them we're in a bell tower on a hill, and we're not going anywhere.
units.name: KRUGER

units.text: Will you let me ring it?
units.name: BROTHER ANSELMO

units.text: No.
units.name: KRUGER

units.text: It would tell them we are here.
units.name: BROTHER ANSELMO

units.text: They know we are here.
units.name: KRUGER

units.text: It would tell them we are still alive.
units.name: BROTHER ANSELMO

units.text: Kruger lowers the rifle and looks at him.
He studies him for a long moment.
In the valley, a rooster crows.
Bogdanov.
units.name: KRUGER

units.text: Sergeant?
units.name: BOGDANOV

units.text: Cover the second window.
units.name: KRUGER

units.text: Yes, sir.
units.name: BOGDANOV

units.text: Father. One ring.
units.name: KRUGER

units.text: One ring.
units.name: BROTHER ANSELMO
